messages:
maya: monitoring alert — multiple control-plane heartbeats for syd1 dropped to 0 at 03:21 UTC :rotating_light:
ops-bot: automated-detect: region-blackhole pattern matched for syd1, paging oncall (maya). Runbook: /runbooks/region-failover.md
jonathan: oncall here, looking at cluster health + kube events
li: seeing big BGP withdraws from our provider peer in syd1, not just our VPC. ASN paths showing withdraws -> possible provider fabric issue
maya: can we start a controlled traffic shift to syd2? want to avoid full cutover until we know state of session stores
daria: session-replication lag ~28s (redis replica lag). Canaries should be safe if we do sticky session fallback. DB writes buffered for ~30s
jonathan: trying to access control-plane nodes — ssh and API timeouts from our jumpbox. node s-replica-3 completely unreachable
li: traceroute -> blackhole at provider-edge 10.64.2.1, packets die there. Opening TAC with provider now (INC-987654).
maya: ok initiating canary shift: 10% traffic to syd2, policy = preserve reserved pools + prefer gpu-dedicated when available. Starting in 2m.
maya: run (internal):
```
POST https://ops-api.internal/v1/traffic-shift
{"from":"syd1","to":"syd2","percent":10,"strategy":"canary-sticky"}
```
ops-bot: traffic-shift job queued (job_id=4321). Will report progress and rollback on >2% error-rate spike
daria: watch list -> latency, 5xx rate, token-cost delta, session-loss. Setting temporary alerts now
jonathan: adding provider contact to thread; if no update in 15m we'll escalate to multi-cloud failover plan and exec brief
li: provider acknowledged TAC, engineer says they're seeing a fabric flap and are running a route-refresh. Case ref: 12345. ETA unknown
maya: noted. documenting timeline in incident doc: https://redwood/incident/1881234567 — keep comms to this thread. Use :loudspeaker: only for customer-impacted updates
daria: canary traffic at 10% -> no errors so far, latency +3ms, 5xx stable. ops-bot will post metrics snapshot every minute
ops-bot: metrics snapshot: canary=10% traffic -> 5xx=0.4% (baseline 0.3%), p95 latency +3ms, session-failures 0.1%
jonathan: still can't reach control-plane from syd1 control subnet; control-plane telemetry stopped at 03:21 UTC. Likely provider edge outage rather than our internal bug
li: provider says they're performing route flap mitigation, will update in 10m. Preparing plan B: accelerate traffic shift to 50% and enable cross-region sticky tokens if provider doesn't stabilize
maya: agreed. If provider doesn't respond in 10m, we move to 50% canary and notify support + customers. Escalation owners: maya (incident lead), jonathan (sre lead), li (network lead), daria (data lead)
ops-bot: incident created 1881234567 by maya. Addendum: paging history logged.
